review_method: Static reading of implementation, proof, qualification source, recorded results and board custody; hash comparison only. No scientific test rerun.

checks.reason: For d>b>=E[D], d-E[D]>=d-b>0. Since sd(D)<=smax, (d-E[D])/sd(D)>=(d-b)/smax. Normal upper tail is decreasing. Degenerate variance produces no positive-threshold rejection.

Exact-rational envelope uses coefficients (w,-f), including all local-background covariances. Triangle/Cauchy-Schwarz gives smax=sum abs(w_i)*sigma_i+abs(f)*sigma_B; rank-one covariance attains the bound.
Threshold inversion yields a superuniform p under each admitted null. p=1 for d<=b is conservative. Fixed finite family Bonferroni requires no cross-test independence.

Exact normalized weights; finite nonboolean numerical inputs; positive sigmas/factor; nonnegative named b; synthetic-only mode; integer positive family; nonfinite standardized contrast and zero underflow tail refused.
36 recorded Gaussian-grid inequalities, 8 refusals, saturation z=1,2,5; source also asserts negative-threshold p=1 and multiplicity. No claim that this finite grid proves the whole class.
Custodied board bytes hash equals snapshot source hash; selected units and X13 entry reproduce exactly from custody; extraction script hash matches. This is integrity, not authentication of an act.

scope_limits: Null centering E[wX-fB]<=b is an explicit model condition. Unknown H0 cancels only under the common-target null E[X_i]=f*H0 plus biases bounded in the contrast; not for arbitrary means merely because sum(w)=1.

Total sigmas, Gaussian sampling, fixed weights/factor/family and independently justified null mean bound remain caller obligations; this component does not authenticate them or qualify physical observable maps.
A source label is not validation. b=0 is a named assumption. No finite result here covers unbounded bias, data-selected weights/factor or estimated K correlated with the same data.
erfc is float64, not an interval certificate; the analytic conservative proof is exact while numerical tails remain floating approximations with underflow refusal.
The board snapshot is time-scoped and not an exhaustive search or authenticated ratification. D-H/X13, d72 and observed opening remain separate; no freezing/opening permitted by this artifact.
No observed F9 significance, calibration or theory confirmation is delivered.
